[size=3][b][color=#f4cccc]This mod contains:
[/color][/b]
[/size]- Seelie retexture for the "fairy" trinket

[b][color=#f4cccc][size=3]Colors (change it in the Config):
[/size][/color][/b]
Brilliance (holo-ish blue/white seelie)
Cyan
Pink
Yellow
Green
Purple[s] (yes I know its named Ourple in the files I thought it was funny so I kept it in)[/s]


[b][color=#f4cccc]How to get it working:[/color][/b]

- Have smapi installed
- Download Content Patcher
- Download Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)
- Extract my mod file and put it in your Mods folder
- on title screen or in game go into your config menu and change the seelie color! (its under Oku's Seelie Companions)

[b][color=#f4cccc]Future ideas for the mod[/color][/b]

- more colors if requested
- animation for the seelies similar to the one in Genshin
- Add an optional file to change the parrot trinket's look as well 
- Add Shiki Taishou/Koshou and Endora to the mod

I'll also take any suggestions you have :3


let me know if there are any issues with the mod!

feel free to edit the files for personal use, I don't mind.

[size=4][color=#fff2cc]If you like my mods, consider giving me a tip on[/color] [url=https://ko-fi.com/bunnyoku]Kofi [/url]^-^
